failures.root_cause: sw-cleanup.sh dry-run mode does not detect stale heartbeat files or emit the expected 'Found N' summary with '--force' hint
failures.fix: Fix the heartbeat detection logic in sw-cleanup.sh to scan the heartbeats directory and output matching lines ('agent-1', 'Found', '--force hint') in dry-run mode

failures.root_cause: sed receives substitution pattern as a filename instead of an expression — missing -e flag causes `s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g` to be interpreted as a file path
failures.fix: Add the -e flag before the sed expression: `sed -e "s|$TEST_TEMP_DIR|...|g"` to distinguish the script from a filename

failures.pattern: mktemp: failed to create directory via template ‘/tmp/claude/sw-test-XXXXXX’: No such file or directory
failures.root_cause: mktemp fails because /tmp/claude directory does not exist on this CI runner
failures.fix: Add 'mkdir -p /tmp/claude' before running tests, or change mktemp template to use /tmp directly (mktemp -d /tmp/sw-test-XXXXXX)
